situation: My mother-in-law keeps telling me at every family dinner that I should quit my job and stay home with the baby. I'm going back to work in January and it's decided. I like her otherwise.
reply: I know you ask because you love her, and I really appreciate how much you've helped these first months. We've made our decision about January and it's working for us. If I'm ever wrestling with it, you'll be one of the first people I ask.
note: Respond to the love, not the clothes. If it comes up again, repeat the same short line rather than adding reasons.

situation: 每次过年回家，我姑都要当着一桌亲戚说我30岁了还不结婚，让我赶紧找个人。我不想吵，也不想解释。
reply: 姑，谢谢您惦记着我。这事我心里有数，您就放心吧。对了，表弟今年高考考得怎么样？
note: 阶梯里最低的一档就够了：接住好意、不解释，然后换个话题。她再说，就重复同一句。

situation: A coworker saw me eating a sandwich and started telling me all about his keto diet and how bread is 'basically poison'. Second time this week. We sit near each other.
reply: You've mentioned this a couple of times, Nate. I've heard it and I'm happy with what I eat, so let's give food a rest. How did the demo with Brightwell go?
note: Repeated advice gets named once, kindly, and then closed with a new topic.

situation: I told my dad I'm leaving my accounting job in March to open a bakery. He's sent me three articles about small business failure rates. I told him I'd thought it through and he replied 'I'm only trying to help, I don't want you to lose everything.'
reply: I know, Dad, and I love that you're looking out for me. I've done the numbers and I've made my decision. What would really help is you coming to taste the menu on Sunday 11 October.
note: Agree with the intention, keep the position, and give him a way to help that isn't advice. Don't send back counter-statistics.

situation: 跟男朋友吵了一架，找闺蜜小雨吐槽了几句，她就一直劝我分手，说'这种男的你还留着干嘛'。我只是想发泄一下，并没打算分。
reply: 我知道你是心疼我才这么说，谢谢你。不过我现在不是要建议，也没打算分，就是想吐吐槽。你先站我这边听我说完好不好？周六奶茶我请。
note: 回应她的关心，不解释为什么不分；说清楚'我要的是倾听'，比争论他好不好有用。

situation: My retired neighbour Gary gives me lawn tips every time I'm out front on a Saturday (aerate, overseed, mow higher). He's sweet and it's harmless, I just don't want a 20 minute lecture every weekend.
reply: Ha, Gary, you'll make a lawn man of me yet. I'm keeping it low effort this year, dandelions and all. How did your tomatoes end up doing?
note: Low stakes and someone you like: receive it with humour and hand him a topic he enjoys. Save the firmer rungs for if it keeps eating your Saturdays.

situation: Mein Schwiegervater Klaus hat mir beim Sonntagsessen ungefragt gesagt, ich solle meinen Stromvertrag wechseln, ich würde viel zu viel zahlen. Ich habe abgewinkt, aber zu Hause nachgerechnet: Er hat recht, ich spare rund 280 Euro im Jahr. Ich will ihm kurz schreiben.
reply: Hallo Klaus, du hattest recht mit dem Stromvertrag. Ich habe es nachgerechnet, ich spare rund 280 Euro im Jahr und habe heute gewechselt. Danke, dass du es angesprochen hast, auch wenn ich am Sonntag erst abgewunken habe. Beim nächsten Essen bringe ich den Kuchen mit.
note: When the unsolicited advice was right, say so plainly and credit him; it is what makes your future deflections credible.

situation: My sister-in-law Brooke keeps texting me photos of barn venues and telling me we'll 'regret' having a courthouse wedding on Friday December 11 with 12 guests. It's booked and we're happy with it. She sent another one this morning.
reply: Ha, that barn is gorgeous, Brooke. We've booked the courthouse for 11 December and it's exactly what we want, so we're done looking at venues. I'd love your eye on something else though: would you help me pick the flowers for the lunch afterwards?
note: Name the decision once, kindly, and give her care somewhere useful to go, but only if you want her involved. If the photos keep coming: 'We've decided, let's leave venues there.'

situation: I'm five months pregnant. Brenda, a coworker from another team I barely know, saw my latte in the office kitchen and said 'you really shouldn't be having caffeine, it's bad for the baby'. My midwife said one coffee a day is fine.
reply: Thanks, Brenda, my midwife and I have it covered. How's the move to the new floor going?
note: For an acquaintance, the lowest rungs of the ladder: one short line of position and a new subject. Quoting guidelines would only give her something to argue with.

situation: I posted a photo of my 8-month-old napping in the carrier on Instagram and Kerry, a woman I went to school with, commented publicly that babies should only nap in a cot and I'm 'creating bad habits'. About 200 people follow me, mostly friends and family.
reply: Thanks, Kerry! He's a happy little napper either way, and this works for us right now. Hope your two are doing well.
note: In a public comment, stay on the lowest rung: receive it, one line of position, a warm close. Never debate it in the comments.

situation: 我今年63岁，刚退休，决定拿8万块钱报一个半年的老年大学游学团，去云南和欧洲。女儿知道后天天发消息劝我把钱存定期，说“这钱要留着养老”。钱是我自己攒的，退休金也够花。
reply: 闺女，妈知道你是担心我，这份心我收下了。这笔账我算过，退休金和存款都够，游学团也报好了，我想趁还走得动出去看看。你要真想帮我，就帮我挑个好用的翻译软件吧，到了欧洲我怕看不懂菜单。
note: 回应关心，不摊开账本逐条解释；把她的在意引到一件能帮上忙的具体小事上。

situation: My friend Dev made a lot of money on crypto this year and every time we meet he tells me I'm 'an idiot' for keeping my savings in a normal savings account. I've thought about it and I'm not interested. He means well.
reply: Ha, you've made the case well, Dev. I'm keeping my savings where they are, it lets me sleep at night. Genuinely glad it's worked out for you though. Are we still on for five-a-side Thursday?
note: Name your position once, warmly, and change the subject; if he raises it again, repeat the same sentence rather than debating.

situation: 婆婆一直说宝宝8个月了该在米糊里加点糖、喝点果汁，我说医生建议先不加糖，她就说“好好好，以后我什么都不说了”，这两天都不太理我。我不想改决定，但想缓和一下。
reply: 妈，那天我语气急了点，您别往心里去。您带大了两个孩子，经验比我多多了，我知道您是心疼乐乐。加糖这件事我们还是按医生说的先不加，别的事我真的很想听您的。周末您来家里教我做南瓜小米粥吧，乐乐肯定爱吃。
note: When they take offence: apologise for the tone, not the decision, and give them a real role.

situation: At my bouldering gym there's a regular, Phil, maybe 60, who shouts moves at me while I'm on the wall ('left foot higher! use the crimp!'). He's friendly, but I like working problems out myself, and it's happened three sessions in a row.
reply: Thanks, Phil, I know you're rooting for me. I actually like figuring the moves out myself, it's half the fun, so could you hold the tips unless I ask? I'll come find you when I'm properly stuck.
note: Friendly repeat offender: name the preference once, warmly, and give him a role for when you do want help.

situation: 我养了12年的狗豆豆两周前走了。好朋友阿琪每次聊天都劝我赶紧再养一只，说“养只新的就不难受了”，还给我发领养信息。我现在完全没这个心思。
reply: 阿琪，我知道你是看我难受，想让我快点好起来，谢谢你。再养一只的事我现在不考虑，豆豆刚走，我还想好好想它一阵。领养信息先别发给我啦。这周末有空的话，陪我去江边走走吧，以前都是带豆豆去的。
note: 悲伤中的劝告：回应她的心意，立场说一次、不解释，再给她一个能陪你的具体方式。
